connector.name: VASTlint
connector.registryDescription: Validate VAST, VMAP, and DAAST ad tags against IAB specs. 220 rules, pure Rust core.
connector.summary: Hosted at vastlint.org over server sent events, also runs locally from the desktop bundle vastlint-mcp-linux-x86_64.tar.gz. No credential is declared, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aleksuix account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
